headline: Overcorrection fix (neutral options frame when no mover detected): 4 correct / 3 partial / 1 wrong (vs forced-navigate v1: 4/2/2). MARGINAL improvement -- lf52 moved wrong->partial ('move to the same cell as a target' ~= merge), but ft09 stayed wrong: gemma defaults to 'reach an object' even with neutral options. DEEPER LIMIT: the detector cannot yet infer game TYPE (navigate vs merge vs CSP); distinguishing them needs a perceptual signal for game type (multiple same-type objects -> merge; per-cell pattern -> CSP), a larger research step than framing. The 4 navigate wins are stable across both variants.
